dn2:99.1: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

dn2:99.7: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
dn2:100.1: taggha tvaṃ mahārāja accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yo tvaṃ pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ issariyassa kāraṇā jīvitā voropesi
dn2:100.2: yato ca kho tvaṃ mahārāja accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi tante mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
dn2:100.3: vuḍḍhi hesā mahārāja ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
dn2:101.1: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
dn2:101.2: handa cadāni mayaṃ bhante gacchāma bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyāti.
dn2:101.4: athakho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn2:102.1: athakho bhagavā acirapakkantassa rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa bhikkhū āmantesi

dn2:102.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
